subject: Spectra renewal & expansion - usage review + next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@spectraanalytics.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@spectraanalytics.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-03-28T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Spectra renewal & expansion - usage review + next steps

Hi Jennifer and Tom,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps.

Key pain points and goals
- High token spend on nightly batch scoring for QA models; cost pressure as volume grows
- Latency sensitivity for real-time inference on the insights dashboard (goal: p95 < 120ms)
- Need better observability for per-route cost attribution to make capacity decisions

Current usage and opportunity
- You are currently on the Growth plan, avg monthly tokens 180M, peak 14M/day
- Batch scoring is ~65% of token consumption; real-time has strict latency SLOs
- Discussed new workloads: multimodal QA (image+text) pilot and expanded embeddings for semantic search

Proposed expansion path
1) Move batch scoring to a Dedicated pool with autoscale for predictable unit cost
2) Pilot multimodal QA on a dedicated GPU instance for 6 weeks (we can offer preferred rates)
3) Add per-route tracing in Console and a scheduled usage report for 90-day trending

Next steps and timeline
- I will share the Q1 usage report and a draft proposal with pricing for dedicated capacity by EOD Friday
- Jennifer to confirm the pilot scope and internal stakeholders by next Thurs (04/07)
- Schedule renewal + pilot kickoff call for week of 04/11

Attachments: Q1-usage-report.pdf, redwood-proposal-draft.pdf

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0178

From: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@spectraanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@spectraanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra renewal & expansion - usage review + next steps

Thanks Marissa. This is great, appreciate the clear summary.
A couple of clarifications:
- For the multimodal pilot, do you have estimated token and GPU-hour consumption we can budget against?
- On pricing, can you outline the preferred rate you mentioned for a 6-week pilot and the committed reserve for Dedicated?

I'll confirm stakeholders internally by 04/07. Also looping in our procurement lead if needed once we see the draft.

Best,
Jennifer
Head of ML Engineering
Spectra Analytics
jennifer.lee@spectraanalytics.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jennifer Lee <jennifer.lee@spectraanalytics.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@spectraanalytics.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-03-29T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Spectra renewal & expansion - usage review + next steps

Hi Jennifer,

Thanks for the quick reply. See attached Q1-usage-report.pdf which breaks down daily token patterns and per-route cost. Also attached redwood-proposal-v2.pdf with two options: 1) 6-week pilot rate and 2) 12-month Dedicated reserve with stepped pricing.

Estimates for multimodal pilot (rough)
- Token equivalent: 8-15M tokens over 6 weeks depending on query rate
- GPU hours: ~120-200 GPU hours for the pilot (depends on batch size); we can tighten estimates after pilot scope confirmed

Preferred pilot pricing
- Pilot discounted at 30% off list for 6 weeks with option to convert consumed hours to a committed credit if you move to Dedicated

Vivek, can you confirm the pilot approval and draft SOW cadence? Also flag any discount approval needed above standard practice.

Next steps
- Marissa to share proposal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789 (proposal v2)
- Jennifer to confirm pilot scope and stakeholder list by 04/07
- Schedule renewal + pilot kickoff: proposed 04/12 10:00am PT

Attachments: Q1-usage-report.pdf, redwood-proposal-v2.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa
